title: Discipline Lead – Video (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Video-specific BIM content as it relates to Video systems (projectors, LED screens, media servers, pathways) and documentation delivery. Represents Video discipline authority for documentation outcomes derived from BIM.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Video discipline BIM states for use in show/technical and documentation milestones
Acts as Video discipline sign-off authority for documentation readiness
Authority bounded by Video scope and enterprise standards
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
responsibilities: Ensure Video discipline BIM models support accurate, coordinated, and repeatable technical documentation
Align Video resources with project milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve optical throw distances, sightlines, and video drawing quality
Formally approve Video BIM models for documentation use based on externalized monitoring data
Review Video data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: Video BIM content suitability for documentation outputs (display elevations, projector cones, rack layouts)
Video participation in BIM coordination workflows
Video BIM deliverables meeting milestone commitments
approvals: Video discipline BIM model states approved for documentation use
Video drawings, schedules, and device location sheets
inputs: Video engineering designs, throw calculations, and display specifications
BEP and coordination rules from Project BIM Manager / Coordinator
outputs: Video drawings, schedules, and display layouts
